title: Scaffold Hopping
description: Bioisosteric scaffold replacement to find novel chemotypes with similar pharmacophore profiles as the reference compound.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_smiles.description: SMILES file with one 'SMILES compound_id' per line for the compound series to hop.

reference_smiles.description: Reference compound SMILES (default: acetaminophen). Used as pharmacophore template.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of scaffold candidates to report.

lipinski_filter.description: Apply Lipinski rule-of-five filter. Removes compounds with MW>500, logP>5, HBD>5, HBA>10.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
